title: What If California Left the Union?
description: When California secedes and receives foreign backing from Russia, the resulting geopolitical turmoil forces the United States to fight multiple fronts and ultimately forfeit its western territories.
target_audience: History enthusiasts, political strategy fans, and geography commentary viewers.
moral: Internal divisions and foreign intervention can rapidly unravel the territorial integrity of even the most powerful nations.
